name: sjskills-maintenance
description: Check CLI, configured skills, and published plugin status at startup and tell the agent about drift so it can offer a sync.

interface.shortDescription: Report actionable sjskills status at startup.
interface.longDescription: New and resumed sessions run direct read-only status checks. Healthy checks stay silent; actionable or incomplete checks produce one diagnostic for the user and a short summary for the agent naming the affected skills. The agent may only offer an update or sync; it runs one only after the user agrees.
interface.defaultPrompt: Explain my sjskills startup check findings.
